dict.string: Request microphone access to transcribe audio locally
In meeting mode, Handy records the sound of your calls so it can transcribe what the other participants say. Audio is transcribed on this Mac and never saved.
Handy saves your voice notes as Markdown files in Documents › Handy Notes, and keeps the shared dictionary file in sync if you chose a folder there.
Handy reads and updates the shared dictionary file in the folder you chose, so your words stay in sync with the people you share them with.
Handy reads and updates the shared dictionary file in the iCloud Drive, Dropbox or other cloud folder you chose, so your words stay in sync.
Handy adds your voice notes to Apple Notes, only if you turn this on in the Notes settings.
Handy reads your calendar to offer to record your video calls a minute before they start, and to name each meeting and its participants. Handy never changes your calendar.
